A local variable of class type (t t' : TopologicalSpace α) is a local instance inside a def body: to read a partial homeomorphism for a second topology, wrap it (WrappedTop) and use a type synonym carrying it as instance (GX.WithWrappedTop, GX.OpenPartialHomeomorph.retopBTZ).

When a goal quantifies over a type synonym (WithWrappedTop T'), `intro (e : UnderlyingType)` fixes the local's type, otherwise membership/connectedComponentIn lemmas of the underlying type fail with 'synthesized instance not defeq'.

The causality of an E0-manifold in the SingularGXStructure form is GX.e0ManifoldCausality M hM (generated by regular a.e.-atlas charts into 𝕄 and def:atlas E0-charts into 𝔼₀, inside Y = 𝕄 ⊕ 𝔼₀ with E0LM.D); GX.chartAtlasCausality gives tarentin and Z⁺ for any atlas from LocTarentin/LocZplus of the model, no groupoid needed.
